wiki.title: Bo Biteman
wiki.extract: Dennis Dean "Bo" Biteman (born October 23, 1978) is an American politician who serves as President of the Wyoming State Senate and as a Republican member of the Wyoming Senate, representing District 21 since January 7, 2019. He previously served in the Wyoming House of Representatives, representing District 51 from 2017 to 2019, and is a candidate for the United States House of Representatives.
